name: input-group
title: Input Group
description: Input or textarea with pixel addons and buttons inside one sunken field.

typewriter.key.note: Brown-switch bottom-out: keycap edge clack over a short plate resonance and a low thock, all at fixed pitch

typewriter.space.note: Stabilized space bar: deeper plate ring and thock, with a faint stabilizer rattle

typewriter.return.note: Stabilized Enter: the heaviest clack, a touch longer than space
